Our Story

Crafted in
Nagpur.
Trusted
everywhere.

"The best water is water at its most essential — clean, balanced, alive."

Whater was born from a simple belief: everyone deserves access to water that is genuinely clean. Not just treated — but meticulously filtered, tested, and sealed with care.


Manufactured at Plot No. 3A, Gausiya Society, Ring Road, Nagpur — every bottle passes through multi-stage purification before reaching your hands.


No shortcuts. No artificial minerals. No gimmicks. Just water at its purest.

How We Do It

From Source
to Sealed.

1
Source Water

Drawn from a verified, licensed municipal or bore source. Fully logged for traceability.

2
Pre-Filtration

Sediment and carbon filters remove particulates, chlorine, and organic matter.

3
RO Purification

Reverse osmosis membranes eliminate dissolved solids and heavy metals.

4
UV Sterilisation

UV-C light neutralises residual biological contaminants completely.

5
Seal & Ship

Bottles filled, tamper-sealed, batch-coded, and dispatched fresh.
